regeneration.summary: Active hero is a v2 regeneration. The v1 hero (rejected/img_v1-selfreview-rejected.jpg) was rejected in Cora's self-review: v1 yogurt had green herb flecks (reads as tzatziki, which the brief excludes) and a pan pouring in mid-air.
regeneration.prompt_change: v2 prompt = v1 prompt verbatim plus one 'Regeneration clarifier:' sentence inserted before the quality-reference sentence; the Styling line was also changed. See the 'Regeneration v2 prompt addition' section of image-prompt.md.
regeneration.clarifier_sentence: Regeneration clarifier: the yogurt is plain, smooth, pure white with no herbs, no cucumber and no green flecks; nothing is being poured and no pan floats in the air; the butter is already on the plate.

styling_change.v1: Styling: Optional: a small copper pan of brown butter mid-pour in soft focus (no hands).
styling_change.v2: Styling: a small copper pan of brown butter resting on the table in soft focus.
